contract.description: Read and update the project registry: owner config that maps kebab-case aliases to absolute workspace paths (optional boardProjectId and displayName ride along) - the lookup behind project tags on memory writes. One strict-case action enum: List, Add, Update, Remove; a wrong or misspelled action is rejected with the allowed set spelled out. Add needs an alias plus at least one absolute path; Update replaces the whole path list and sets or clears the optional fields; Remove is explicit only. Rare door: the registry is owner config - confirm with the human before changing it, and a running MCP server picks up registry edits on its next start.
contract.name: projects
contract.title: Project registry
